item_arguments_and_dependencies.argument: Defines the explicit 2n+1-dimensional basis and alternating central bracket; its local justified_by lemma verifies bilinearity, alternation in characteristic 2, and Jacobi.
The coordinate formula is bilinear, self-brackets cancel pairwise, and all nested brackets vanish because every bracket is central.
Defines W_n(k;hbar) as the tensor quotient by explicit same-type and cross-commutator relators, with A_n(k)=W_n(k;1).
Expands both traces as finite double sums, swaps dummy indices and commuting entries, and covers d=0.
In a finite basis the relation [D_1,X_1]=hbar I yields 0=hbar dim(M) by the matrix trace lemma; nonzero hbar and characteristic zero contradict dim(M)>0.

PBW gives a k[Z]-free normal basis of U(h_n); quotient by Z-hbar preserves x^alpha p^beta. Explicit maps identify this quotient with the tensor presentation, and a terminating rewriting system has all same-type and mixed overlap ambiguities resolved.
Records the object boundary and exact hypotheses needed before any later analytic integration claim; it proves no bridge theorem.
Differentiation preserves (t^p) because p=0, [D,X]=I on the quotient, and the p lower monomials form a basis.
Multiplication and monomial differentiation satisfy the defining relations; in characteristic p, D_i^p acts as zero although p_i^p is nonzero by the normal basis.
